demo_command: python3 scripts/demo_tour.py --serve (run from a disposable git-archive copy of the pinned HEAD; see docs/uiv2-v2-baseline-evidence.md)
purpose: UIV2-01 baseline: capture every tab at the roadmap viewports/themes from the running app. File names follow the published pane convention: pipeline.png is the council tab, compare.png is the debate tab. Override the viewport per run with --viewport and the theme with --emulate-theme; each variant set goes to its own --out directory.
